ValidationRule.description: SS-4495 - Validate the cloud provider values and enforce when they need to be completed. SS-8288 - Cloud_Region field to replace Taas_Region. Deactivate VR.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ((TEXT(Compliance_Framework__c) = "tc_usg" && TEXT(Cloud_Region__c) != "gov") || (TEXT(Compliance_Framework__c) = "protected_b" && TEXT(Cloud_Region__c) != "ca") || (ISPICKVAL( Server_Device_Type__c , "Tanium as a Service") && TEXT(Cloud_Region__c) = "gov")) && NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Cloud Region "gov (United States)" is reserved for TC_USG customers ONLY and Cloud Region "ca (Canada) is required for ProtectedB customers.
